US President Donald Trump has said Washington wants to allow only older-generation chips to be sold to China, while ruling out access to advanced technology. His remarks come as the administration discusses a comprehensive deal with Beijing following his meeting with Xi Jinping. He also added that he would want NVidia's former CEO Jensen Huang to be given a second chance.
